title: ojd --json output
description: The --json output of each ojd command. Each command's entry in $defs is its command path in lowerCamelCase, such as controllerShow for 'ojd controller show'. Every document has apiVersion, and kind: the kind of the object it prints, such as Controller for 'ojd controller show', or Status for an action that leaves no object to print, whose details hold the command's own result. A list command prints its listed items in items, with no apiVersion or kind of their own, and an empty metadata. Entries that start with 'shared' are shapes that several commands use. A command that streams prints one document per line, and each line matches the entry.

oneOf.description: With --token: the token, shown only this once, and its grant.

controller.description: The controller whose record was layered, as VVVV:PPPP. Absent without --controller.

defaultsFile.description: The all.patch.json path, whether or not the file exists.

profile.description: The active profile whose stick values the profile rows show. Absent without --controller, without a running service, or without an active profile for the controller.

defaultsProblem.description: Why OJD ignored all.patch.json. Absent when it applies or does not exist.

key.description: A record tuning key, or for a profile row the profile file path of the value.

layer.description: The layer that set the value, lowest first.

value.description: Absent while only the Driver default applies.

families.description: The protocol families whose drivers read the key. Present for a tuning key without --controller.

alsoListedBySystem.description: Whether the system also lists the controller as a second controller that gives no input while OJD serves it.

ownedByAnotherClient.description: Whether another client holds the controller's USB interface exclusively.

power.description: The latest power state the controller reports. Absent when the service reports none.

unit.description: The persistent unit ID: stays the same while the controller uses the same port. Absent without a location ID.

waitsForGuidePress.description: Whether the controller has sent no input since its session started and waits for a press of its home button, the PS button of a DualShock 3.

digitalTriggers.description: Triggers the controller reports only as buttons. The others are analog and also derive a button.

outputOwner.description: Who drives the controller's output. With System, macOS serves the controller natively, so the rumble and lighting lists hold only what macOS leaves undone.

serverSource.description: The record layer that sets server, Default when no layer sets it, or Route when the system cannot serve the controller, so server is OJD.

power.description: The latest power state the controller reports. Absent when the service reports none.

publication.description: Whether a virtual device publishes the controller.

failure.description: The text of the failed send. Present exactly when the state is Failed.

lastAttemptedNanoseconds.description: System uptime of the last send to the virtual device.

lastCompletedNanoseconds.description: System uptime of the last send the virtual device accepted.

reason.description: Why no virtual device publishes the controller. Present exactly when the state is NotPublished.

inputMapping.description: Where the HID usage map comes from. Absent unless the HIDDescriptor protocol drives the controller.

record.description: The effective record for the controller's model. Absent when no record matches.

serving.description: How OJD serves the controller, as the serving policy decides it.

persona.description: The persona OJD publishes. Absent for a route that publishes nothing.

reason.description: Why the route publishes nothing. Present only with OutputDisabled.

tuning.description: The effective record's tuning as applied. Absent when the record sets no tuning.

unit.description: The persistent unit ID: stays the same while the controller uses the same port. Absent without a location ID.

overrideScope.description: Whether override is the controller's own choice or its model's.

controllerWatch.description: With --first-press, the first control pressed; with --all, one event per line for every controller; with --output, one controller state and the virtual gamepad's values per line; otherwise one controller state per line.

output.description: Absent when the controller is not published.

oneOf.description: With --all, one watch line per line.

timings.description: The newest frames of each connected controller, oldest first; empty while the service is stopped. Nanoseconds are on the service's monotonic uptime clock. frames lists the newest 8 frames of each controller; summary covers the window of its newest 15000 frames. The endpoint polls, so DeliveryEndpoint goes on the newest frame at the poll and a frame replaced by a newer one before the poll gets none.

exitCode.description: The exit code of a command-line error.

wire.description: The wire value of a remapping error.

lines.description: The number of log lines written.

logShow.description: A snapshot of each log, or with -f one line per log line.

value.description: The value at key in the profile file, which profile.schema.json describes.

profileValidate.description: A valid profile has every property except problem. An invalid profile has only valid and problem.

differences.description: The fields of the controller state that differ. Empty when the states match.

actual.description: The parsed value of the field, as JSON text.

expected.description: The expected value of the field, as JSON text.

record.description: The drafted controller record, as 'ojd record install' reads it.

sharedAPIVersion.description: The version of the ojd --json output format.

reason.description: The endpoint error code of the refusal; see the wiki page Error-Codes.

name.description: The grant the token belongs to; absent for a token that matches no grant.

reason.description: The endpoint error code of the refusal; see the wiki page Error-Codes.

sharedConfigChange.description: The result of config set and config unset: the tuning key and its value before the change.

controller.description: The controller model whose record the change writes, as VVVV:PPPP. Absent for all.patch.json.

created.description: Whether the change creates the user file.

file.description: The user file the change writes or removes.

previous.description: The effective value before the change. Absent while only the Driver default applies.

removesFile.description: Whether the change removes the file because it leaves no key in a patch.

value.description: The value set. Absent for config unset.

sharedControllerServer.description: The result of claim and release: the model's server setting before and after.

created.description: Whether the change creates the user record file.

file.description: The user record file the change writes.

sharedControllerWatchEvent.description: A watch line: ADDED for a controller that connected, including those connected when the stream starts (the endpoint's snapshot carries the full current object); MODIFIED when its input changes; DELETED when it disconnected, with the last object. The line has no apiVersion and kind of its own; its object does. Lines of ojd controller watch --all and of the endpoint's controllers stream.

sharedExclusiveOwner.description: The client that holds the controller's USB interface exclusively, as the interface names it. Absent when none does or the interface names none.

name.description: The process name, which the kernel truncates to 16 characters, or the class of the kernel driver.

processID.description: The owning process. Absent when a kernel driver holds the interface.

sharedFrameTimingSummary.description: What the frame window of one controller says about stutter. A gap lists median, 99th percentile (nearest rank) and maximum over the frames that reached both of its stages, and is absent when no frame did. ReadToRead is the time between the Read stamps of consecutive frames. A stall is a read interval longer than 3 times the median ReadToRead; the threshold follows the report rate of the controller. ReadToRead and stalls are measured only on a window of lastSeconds, which the user fills with constant input, because a controller that reports only when an input changes leaves a gap for each pause; the whole ring, without lastSeconds, has neither. stalls is also absent when the window holds fewer than two frames.

lastSeconds.description: The seconds before the service answered that the window covers (ojd diagnose --frames); absent for the whole ring.

spanNanoseconds.description: From the first to the last Read stamp of the window.

count.description: The read intervals longer than the threshold.

sharedTuningKey.description: A tuning key of a controller record or of all.patch.json.

sharedServer.description: Who serves the controller model, the server setting: System leaves it to the system, OJD lets OpenJoystickDriver seize it and publish a virtual gamepad.

sharedWatchedController.description: A Controller: the fields of an item of ojd controller list, and the latest input and output once the controller has any.

id.description: The ID from ojd controller list.

input.description: The latest input; absent until the controller has input state.

output.description: With --output, or a subscription that asked for output. Absent when the controller is not published.

sharedStatus.description: A Kubernetes Status: the result of an action that leaves no object to print. details is the command's own result; each command's entry in $defs constrains it.

sharedVirtualFeedLine.description: One output command per line that the host sent to the virtual gamepad, oldest first. Virtual gamepads receive only rumble commands.

durationMilliseconds.description: How long the rumble lasts. Absent while it is held until the next rumble command.

sharedVirtualSDL.description: The SDL mapping of a virtual gamepad profile, derived from its report descriptor and report codec. The GUID carries a zero CRC.

mapping.description: One SDL mapping line: the GUID, the name, the bindings, and platform:Mac OS X, ending in a comma.

worksWithDefaultSDLHints.description: Whether SDL recognizes the profile with its default hints, as the profile's definition states.

sharedVirtualW3C.description: The W3C Gamepad description of a virtual gamepad profile: for each index of the standard layout, the control and the input of the virtual gamepad that supplies it. A source is bN for a button, aN for an axis and h0.MASK for a hat direction, numbered as SDL numbers them.

sharedVirtualOutput.description: What the virtual gamepad last reported, after stick transfer and remapping. Stick Y points down, as in the HID report.

buttons.description: Bit n is HID button n + 1.

commandLineTool.description: The ojd link the app installs: Installed when it points to this app's executable, LinkedElsewhere when it points to another existing file such as another app copy, Broken when its target does not exist, BlockedByFile when the path is a file or folder that is not a link, and Missing when nothing is at the path. target is what the link points to and appears only for a link.

listenerFailure.description: Present while the service is stopped and left a record that its request listener stopped.

message.description: The code with its localized text, the error number and the time.

current.description: True while the process that recorded the failure runs; false when the service is not running and the failure is why its last listener stopped.

listenerFailureProblem.description: Present while the service is stopped and the record of its listener failure cannot be used: the localized problem.

mappings.description: One entry per virtual gamepad profile, with only the member of the requested format.

overrideScope.description: Whether override is the controller's own choice or its model's.

sdl.description: The SDL mapping of the controller's live virtual gamepad. Absent with no virtual gamepad.

w3c.description: The W3C Gamepad description of the controller's live virtual gamepad. Absent with no virtual gamepad.
